ex.s: The goal of this book is to make the case for digital minimalism, including a detailed exploration of what it asks and why it works, and then to teach you how to adopt this philosophy if you decide it’s right for you.
ex.t: 这本书的目标是论证数字极简主义，包括详细探讨它的要求及其为何有效，然后教你如何采纳这一理念——如果你认定它适合你的话。

ex.s: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism, starting with an examination of the forces that are making so many people’s digital lives increasingly intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
ex.t: 在第一部分，我阐述了数字极简主义的哲学基础，先审视那些让许多人的数字生活越来越难以忍受的力量，接着详细讨论数字极简主义理念。

ex.s: Part one concludes by introducing my suggested method for adopting this philosophy: the digital declutter.
ex.t: 第一部分最后介绍了我建议的践行这一理念的方法：数字清理。

ex.s: In the final chapter of part one, I’ll guide you through carrying out your own digital declutter.
ex.t: 在第一部分的最后一章，我将指导你完成自己的数字清理。

ex.s: In doing so, I’ll draw on an experiment I ran in 2018 in which over 1,600 people agreed to perform a digital declutter.
